event.description:
Grand Archive Regionals will be taking place at Good Games Town Hall, do you have what it takes to win the serialized National qualifier card?! Come by and compete for your chance to win!
𝗘𝘃𝗲𝗻𝘁 𝗗𝗲𝘁𝗮𝗶𝗹𝘀:
𝗪𝗵𝗲𝗻: 4/5/2025
𝗥𝗲𝗴𝗶𝘀𝘁𝗿𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻: Opens at 10:30 AM
𝗘𝘃𝗲𝗻𝘁 𝗦𝘁𝗮𝗿𝘁: 11:00 AM
𝗘𝗻𝘁𝗿𝘆 𝗙𝗲𝗲: $50
𝗠𝗮𝘅𝗶𝗺𝘂𝗺 𝗖𝗮𝗽𝗮𝗰𝗶𝘁𝘆: 64 Players
𝗙𝗼𝗿𝗺𝗮𝘁: Standard Constructed, best of 3, swiss rounds into Top Cut
𝗣𝗿𝗶𝘇𝗲 𝗦𝘁𝗿𝘂𝗰𝘁𝘂𝗿𝗲:
Winner - HVN Season Regional Championship Playmat, National Qualifier Card
Placements (based on attendance) - HVN Season Regional Finalist Playmat, National Qualifier Card
Participation - Abyssal Heaven Event Packs, Abyssal Heaven Booster Packs, the new Regionals Binder, as well as the new Abyssal Heaven Sapphire Pack!
Players require a valid Omnidex ID, and to be in good standing with Weebs of the Shore to participate.
Players can create an Omnidex ID here: https://omni-beta.gatcg.com/

host.name: Good Games Town Hall
